body.purpose: Instructions, descriptions and readable interface copy.

label.purpose: Chain, game, event, status and measurement metadata.

shadows.name: transaction-overlay
shadows.purpose: Separate temporary transaction feedback from the page.

motion.name: interaction
motion.purpose: Button fill, arrow and row feedback.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapse nonessential transition and loading motion.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: A decisive rectangular action for create, register and claim.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 16px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; border: 1px solid #101010; border-radius: 0; background: #101010; color: #fff; font: 9px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .035em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #f3f2ee; color: #101010; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #101010; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Quiet Action
components.description: A text-led secondary action with a structural underline.
components.css: .ds-quiet { min-height: 44px; padding: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #b9b8b2; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #101010; font: 9px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-quiet:hover { border-color: #101010; } .ds-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #101010; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Monospaced Field
components.description: A square, low-chrome field for entity IDs and numeric settings.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #101010; font: 9px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .05em; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #101010; border-radius: 0; background: #f3f2ee; color: #101010; font: 16px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #101010; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Competition Row
components.description: A numbered ruled record for an event, not a promotional card.
components.css: .ds-event { min-height: 72px; padding: 14px 12px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 16px; border-top: 1px solid #b9b8b2; color: #101010; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 9px; } .ds-event strong { font: 500 15px 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; } .ds-event:hover { background: #101010; color: #fff; } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-event { grid-template-columns: 34px 1fr auto; gap: 9px; } .ds-event > :last-child { grid-column: 2 / 4; } }

components.name: State Trace
components.description: The connected seven-step path from foreign game state to sponsored reward.
components.html:
1. ONCHAIN GAME CHAINMMO
  2. CANONICAL STATE BEST LEVEL
  3. COMPETITION +3
  4. BASELINE 17
  5. TARGET 20
  6. VERIFICATION LIVE READ
  7. REWARD 1 MON
components.css: .ds-trace { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; background: #101010; color: #fff; font: 8px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; } .ds-trace li { min-height: 36px; position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 0 12px 0 30px; border-left: 1px solid #777; } .ds-trace li::before { width: 7px; height: 7px; position: absolute; left: -4px; border: 1px solid #fff; background: #101010; content: ''; } .ds-trace b { font-weight: 500; }

narrative.overview:
Arovaq treats competition as a legible path through a game's existing canonical state. A seven-step trace moves from game and state, through the participant's baseline and target, into verification and reward. It gives each screen a product-specific visual grammar instead of relying on generic dashboard cards.

The interface pairs editorial scale with compact protocol notation. Large, tightly set headlines establish the stakes; ruled rows, exact numbers and monospace labels make the mechanics inspectable. The palette stays monochrome, with black surfaces marking active systems and important state changes.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial headline scale balanced by technical labels.
State progression shown as a connected trace and measured rail.
Square geometry and thin rules instead of rounded card stacks.

rules.name: The State Trace Rule
rules.body: Arovaq screens should make the relationship between canonical game state, participant baseline, target, verification and reward easy to follow.

rules.name: The Monochrome Rule
rules.body: Use state inversion and typographic hierarchy to distinguish important states; do not introduce a brand accent color.

rules.name: The Scale Contrast Rule
rules.body: Pair one oversized statement with quiet but readable metadata; do not give every label headline weight.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Prefer rules and tonal inversion; reserve elevation for an overlay that must sit above current content.

dos: Do use rules, alignment and state inversion to structure the experience.
Do make canonical numbers and participant-specific baselines visually prominent.
Do keep chain and game metadata monospace and concise.
Do reduce nonessential motion when prefers-reduced-motion is active.
donts: Don't use gradients, glass effects, pill-heavy controls or generic dashboard card grids.
Don't imply chronological first achievement; settlement is by first valid claim.
Don't use color to imply live mainnet deployment or reward activity that is not configured.
